import re

program = r"""
PASTE THE ASSIGNMENTS HERE
"""

state = {}
for line in program.splitlines():
    line = line.split("//", 1)[0]
    for statement in line.split(";"):
        match = re.fullmatch(
            r"\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*<-\s*(-?\d+|[A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*",
            statement,
        )
        if match:
            name, rhs = match.groups()
            state[name] = int(rhs) if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+", rhs) else state[rhs]

names = ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {state[name]}" for name in names))
